payload.title: Assembling the proxy database from the LiPDVerse
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the process of assembling a proxy database from the LiPDVerse, focusing on data querying and cleaning. It utilizes datasets from PAGES2k, iso2k, and CoralHydro2k compilations, downloading and extracting data from specified URLs. The notebook employs various Python libraries to manipulate and analyze the data, including handling duplicates and special cases like the Palmyra record. The final output is a cleaned database stored in a pickle file.
